content: If you have the 8T, you can stack both nozzle boxes to support the bed.

In my opinion it makes more sense to perform the next step first (insert the nuts into the new part). Otherwise you have a bed hanging from the front while you add the nuts. If you did it before you can just continue.
INDX + GEN 2 UPGRADE: Once the motors are unplugged and the left panel and cover are removed, return to the Prusa INDX guide step REMOVING THE REAR BED SPACER, and continue from there.
